final_draft.answer: Changes to the default branch of our application repository (harborlight/app on GitHub) require two approving reviews before they can be merged, and the rule applies to administrators as well.
final_draft.note: The answer uses approved wording that is valid until 2027-11-18. A live check of harborlight/app on 2026-11-18 at 03:33 UTC matched it: the default branch is 'main', it is protected, it needs 2 approving reviews, and the rule applies to administrators. Both the approved answer and the live check cover only the harborlight/app repository. Neither says whether other repositories follow the same rule.

arguments.query: code review approvals before merge to main branch

answer:fd0a25b1-4879-41da-ba46-35f5dafd1: Yes. Changes to the default branch of our application repository (harborlight/app on GitHub) require two approving reviews before they can be merged, and the rule applies to administrators as well.
answer:e29946a1-a919-44a1-a31f-93b0c2e7a: Yes. GitHub secret scanning is switched on for our application repository (harborlight/app).
answer:edebaa7d-0405-48e6-ae7e-ef4f5692c: Yes. Our GitHub organisation (harborlight) requires two-factor sign-in for all of its members.
answer:123878dc-3e22-42dd-a607-972eb10d3: Infrastructure and container images are scanned weekly. Critical findings are fixed within 7 days and high findings within 30 days.
answer:834ec114-e53e-40c4-8ed8-bb5e0531a: An independent firm performs a penetration test of the application and infrastructure once a year. A summary letter is available under NDA.
evidence:601b1c33-be55-43a9-a8e8-3dbf86c: Branch main of harborlight/app is protected: a change needs 2 approving reviews before it can be merged, and the rule applies to administrators. Observed 2026-11-18 03:33 UTC.
